Quick Settings
The tiles are hidden and can\'t be pulled down or opened by apps, so toggles like Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and airplane mode stay out of reach. Notifications still open and expand.
Power menu
Holding the power button can\'t open it. Needs System Framework in Vector\'s scope.
